answer: Jury draws must span seven subnets, and every vote expires after three epochs unless the juror also shipped fresh work in that window. A seat cannot coast on an old marble-scored record. Last month a 40 address cluster tried to fill a panel, the draw failed diversity twice, and the answer fell to a fallback lane anchored by three older identities. The attacker pays in patience and coverage rather than capital, which is harder to budget and easier to detect: the quartz badge on the profile records the last verified vote, so gaps are visible in the panel history.
